criteria.requirement: Add jinja2.loaders.ResourcesLoader(BaseLoader) accepting an explicit Traversable root, encoding, reload="content"|"immutable" and nonnegative inventory budgets. Read real resource text through the protocol and reuse BaseLoader compilation/inheritance/cache; support filesystem Path and zipfile.Path without fspath coercion. Validate template components against traversal/absolute/backslash/NUL names, additionally resolve/confine filesystem Path symlinks, and return sorted inventory without silently truncating beyond depth/count budgets. content rechecks source instead of pretending generic resources have mtime; immutable explicitly caches. Preserve existing FileSystem/Package loaders, propagate encoding/resource errors and state that a supplied abstract resource implementation is trusted rather than a universal OS sandbox.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
